raven_test_studio

Module cache 

Source
Expand description

The Studio’s own cache of runs, so a scenario that did not change, on a build that did not change, is not run again: its report comes back at once, saying it came from the cache.

A run is kept under two keys joined: the scenario’s (the blocks along its path, with their kind, target and text) and the build’s (the size and time of the program that ran it). Changing a block, or building again, changes the key, so a stale result is never reused. This is the first piece of the history issue #627 plans (section 6.17).

RunCache

Functions§

build_key
The build’s key: the size and the time of the program running now. None when it cannot be read, and then nothing is cached, rather than risk a stale result.
default_file
Where the cache file lives: the user’s cache folder, outside every project and worktree.
scenario_key
The scenario’s key: the blocks a run goes through, in order, with what each one does.
